sloka: अग्रतो निषसाद अथ विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः ।अथ रामो महातेजा विश्वामित्रम् तपोधनम् ॥१-३१-२२॥
transliteration: agrato niṣasāda atha viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ।atha rāmo mahātejā viśvāmitram tapodhanam ॥1-31-22॥

translations.english: Thereafter highly lustrous Rama, the best among men, filled with curiosity enquired of the great sage Viswamitra:
